W54

Grade correction and regrade review

/teach/courses/:courseId/grading/requests/:requestId
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S19, S09

Resolve a typed assessment-linked review request with a recorded decision and explicit held correction, without direct messaging.

Entry and return
W51 request badgeW48 review requestsW23 learner request handoff
Layout regions
RequestLearner, exact release/receipt/question, submitted reason and request history
EvidenceOriginal response, rubric/policy version and released feedback
DecisionAccept for review, request typed clarification, decline reason or held correction preview

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Resolve review request
  • Decision, learner-visible reason and whether score changes
  • Approved correction remains held until separate release
Return without applying changesRecord decision
Permissions
  • Instructor decides requests and approves corrections; TA reviews/proposes only within current assigned course scope and expiry.
  • Students submit structured requests from their own feedback; no direct-message channel is created.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Declining a request leaves score, receipt and release history unchanged.
  • A correction to released work creates R2 only after W53; R1 remains readable.
  • TA cannot approve/release a correction outside current assigned learner/question scope.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
